block.gemsind.counter.tooltip: Holds an Item, can be used to crack Geodes with a Hammer.
block.gemsind.acid_purifier.tooltip: Increases a Gem's Purity. Using an Acid too strong for that Gem will destroy it. However, you can keep a Gem in a weaker acid for longer for the same effect, but it will take MUCH longer.
block.gemsind.desalinator.tooltip: Extracts a Salt from a Fluid below it, powered by Furnace Fuel.
block.gemsind.centrifuge.tooltip: Increases a Gem's Purity, powered by Furnace Fuel. Fuel and Gems can be inputted from any side. If the Fuel turns into another item on consumption (like Lava Buckets turn into Buckets), they will be outputted.
block.gemsind.tumbler.tooltip: Increases a Gem's Polish, powered by Furnace Fuel. Fuel and Gems can be inputted from any side. If the Fuel turns into another item on consumption (like Lava Buckets turn into Buckets), they will be outputted.
block.gemsind.alloying_furnace.tooltip: Powered by Anthracite. Creates an Alloy out of 2 (or more) Element Gems and 1 (or more) Flux Gems. Alloys gain value based on their input Element and Flux Gems' value (Enargite Cu > Malachite Cu).
item.gemsind.hammer.tooltip: Used to crack Geodes, put a Geode on a Counter and then Right Click the top face of the Counter while holding a Pick in your offhand.
item.gemsind.pick.tooltip: Used to detect Geodes. Picks of weaker materials may not be able to detect certain Geodes.
item.gemsind.acid_pack.tooltip: Used to Refill an Acid Purifier. If the Acid Purifier already has Acid of another type, it will immediately Refill and Replace the Acid with this Acid Pack.
item.gemsind.netherrack_geode.tooltip: Found in Netherrack close to the top of the Nether.
item.gemsind.mountain_geode.tooltip: Found near the top of the tallest Mountains.
item.gemsind.lava_geode.tooltip: Found under lava oceans in the Nether.
